sentences.sk: Volám sa Eva a bývam v malom byte v meste.
sentences.en: My name is Eva, and I live in a small apartment in the city.
Every morning I get up at seven.

sentences.sk: Najprv otvorím okno a pozriem sa von.
sentences.en: First I open the window and look outside.

sentences.sk: Dnes svieti slnko, ale vonku je ešte chladno.
sentences.en: Today the sun is shining, but it is still chilly outside.

sentences.sk: V kuchyni si pripravím čaj a chlieb so syrom.
sentences.en: In the kitchen I make tea and bread with cheese.

sentences.sk: Moja mačka Mica čaká pri dverách.
sentences.en: My cat Mica waits by the door.

sentences.sk: Dám jej jedlo a čerstvú vodu.
sentences.en: I give her food and fresh water.

sentences.sk: Potom sa umyjem a oblečiem si modrý sveter.
sentences.en: Then I wash and put on a blue sweater.

sentences.sk: Na stole ležia môj telefón a kľúče.
sentences.en: My phone and keys are on the table.
I have my phone, but I cannot see my keys.

sentences.sk: Hľadám ich v kuchyni aj v izbe.
sentences.en: I look for them in the kitchen and in the room.
Finally I find them next to a book.

sentences.sk: Je už osem hodín, preto sa ponáhľam.
sentences.en: It is already eight o’clock, so I am in a hurry.

sentences.sk: Z bytu idem pešo na zastávku.
sentences.en: I walk from the apartment to the bus stop.
On the way I meet my neighbor, Mrs. Nováková.

sentences.sk: Pozdravím ju a spýtam sa, ako sa má.
sentences.en: I greet her and ask how she is.

sentences.sk: Hovorí, že sa má dobre, a želá mi pekný deň.
sentences.en: She says she is well and wishes me a nice day.

sentences.sk: Na zastávke čaká veľa ľudí, no autobus príde skoro.
sentences.en: Many people are waiting at the stop, but the bus arrives soon.

sentences.sk: Sadnem si k oknu a pozerám sa na ulice.
sentences.en: I sit by the window and look at the streets.

glossary.note: Used with je to describe cold weather.
Feminine accusative form, agreeing with vodu.
Used with the genitive case: vedľa knihy.
Present tense, first person singular; used with sa.
Describes walking rather than taking transport.
Accusative singular after the direction preposition na.

questions.explanationEn: Eva says she gets up at seven.
She finally finds the keys next to a book.
